question: In a code language, 'MUMBAI' is written as ‘N46’ and ‘KOLKATA’ is written as ‘L60’. How will 'LUCKNOW' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic:** (First letter +1) and sum of the place value of the rest the letter = code of the word.**

'MUMBAI' is written as ‘N46’
